invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of records.collectAsList(), which is expected to be non-null unless the source is corrupted.
The parameter records is used directly without a null check, implying non-nullness is assumed.
Since result is records.collectAsList(), their isEmpty() states must match.
The result and records.collectAsList() are the same object, so their sizes always match.
The returned list is exactly records.collectAsList(), so equality holds at the return point.
